name: First Light Shelter
description: First Light is downtown Birmingham's only emergency shelter accepting homeless women and women with children around the clock, accommodating up to 38 guests. Beyond a bed, nutritious meals, and hygiene essentials, First Light provides social workers, group therapy, and Shelter Plus Care permanent supportive housing for women who are homeless due to disabling conditions such as mental illness, past substance use, or HIV/AIDS, connecting guests to healthcare, job training, and housing assistance.
description_es: First Light es el único refugio de emergencia en el centro de Birmingham que acepta a mujeres sin hogar y mujeres con niños las 24 horas, con capacidad para 38 huéspedes. Además de una cama, comidas nutritivas y artículos de higiene, First Light ofrece trabajadoras sociales, terapia de grupo y vivienda de apoyo permanente Shelter Plus Care para mujeres sin hogar por condiciones incapacitantes como enfermedad mental, uso de sustancias pasado o VIH/SIDA.
eligibility: Women and women with children experiencing homelessness; 24-hour walk-in intake; Shelter Plus Care permanent supportive housing requires a documented disabling condition and referral through the Jefferson County Housing Authority.
eligibility_es: Mujeres y mujeres con niños sin hogar; admisión sin cita las 24 horas; la vivienda de apoyo permanente Shelter Plus Care requiere una condición incapacitante documentada y referencia a través de la Autoridad de Vivienda del Condado de Jefferson.
notes: Call 205-323-4277 or walk in any time; guests receive an individualized case plan with a social worker; donated hygiene products, laundry detergent, and linens are distributed nightly.
notes_es: Llame al 205-323-4277 o preséntese en cualquier momento; las huéspedes reciben un plan de caso individualizado con una trabajadora social; se distribuyen productos de higiene, detergente y ropa de cama donados cada noche.
services: 24-hour emergency shelter for women and children|Shelter Plus Care permanent supportive housing|Social work and group therapy|Hygiene and laundry access|Healthcare and job training referrals

name: Waterfront Rescue Mission — Mobile Campus
description: Waterfront Rescue Mission's Mobile campus, long known locally as Mobile Rescue Mission, offers 110 beds for men in its Christ-centered Addiction Recovery Program and for overnight shelter guests. Non-program guests may stay each month for a $10 co-pay, with bad-weather nights and holidays free for those without income. Weekday day services include hot meals, chaplaincy support, restroom access, clothing, and connections to veteran care and work-training programs.
description_es: El campus de Mobile de Waterfront Rescue Mission, conocido localmente como Mobile Rescue Mission, ofrece 110 camas para hombres en su Programa de Recuperación de Adicciones centrado en Cristo y para huéspedes de refugio nocturno. Los huéspedes fuera del programa pueden quedarse cada mes por un copago de $10, con noches de mal clima y días festivos gratis para quienes no tienen ingresos. Los servicios diurnos entre semana incluyen comidas calientes, capellanía, acceso a baños, ropa y conexiones a cuidado de veteranos y capacitación laboral.
eligibility: Adult men seeking shelter or addiction recovery in the Mobile area; day services available to men, women, and children Monday–Friday; program interviews required for the residential recovery track.
eligibility_es: Hombres adultos que buscan refugio o recuperación de adicciones en el área de Mobile; servicios diurnos disponibles para hombres, mujeres y niños de lunes a viernes; se requieren entrevistas de programa para la vía de recuperación residencial.
notes: Call 251-433-1847 for shelter availability or to schedule a recovery program interview; day services run Monday–Friday, 9:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m., offering meals, chaplain visits, and clothing requests.
notes_es: Llame al 251-433-1847 para disponibilidad de refugio o para programar una entrevista del programa de recuperación; los servicios diurnos son de lunes a viernes de 9:30 a.m. a 3:00 p.m., con comidas, visitas de capellán y solicitudes de ropa.
hours: Overnight shelter nightly; day services Monday–Friday, 9:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
services: Overnight emergency shelter|Residential addiction recovery program|Day services and hot meals|Veteran care|Work training

name: Friendship Mission
description: Friendship Mission is a faith-centered refuge for the River Region's homeless and hungry, operating separate shelters for men and for women and children plus a public soup kitchen serving meals daily. The Caring Center provides free clothing to residents at no charge, and staff help guests work toward self-sufficiency through case management, referrals, and structured shelter programming across Montgomery, Autauga, Elmore, Lowndes, and Macon counties.
description_es: Friendship Mission es un refugio centrado en la fe para las personas sin hogar y con hambre de la región del río, con refugios separados para hombres y para mujeres con niños, además de un comedor público que sirve comidas diariamente. El Caring Center proporciona ropa gratuita a los residentes sin costo, y el personal ayuda a los huéspedes a lograr la autosuficiencia mediante manejo de caso, referencias y programación estructurada de refugio en los condados de Montgomery, Autauga, Elmore, Lowndes y Macon.
eligibility: Men, women, and children experiencing homelessness in the River Region; call the main line and press 3 to speak with intake staff about shelter availability at either location.
eligibility_es: Hombres, mujeres y niños sin hogar en la región del río; llame a la línea principal y presione 3 para hablar con el personal de admisión sobre disponibilidad de refugio en cualquiera de las ubicaciones.
notes: Women's Shelter is at 312 Chisholm Street; soup kitchen at the Men's Shelter serves Monday–Saturday 12:30 p.m. and 5:30 p.m., Sunday 9:30 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.; clothing donations go to The Caring Center, 380 Arba Street.
notes_es: El refugio de mujeres está en 312 Chisholm Street; el comedor en el refugio de hombres sirve de lunes a sábado a las 12:30 p.m. y 5:30 p.m., domingo a las 9:30 a.m. y 5:30 p.m.; las donaciones de ropa van al Caring Center, 380 Arba Street.
hours: Shelters 24/7; soup kitchen daily per posted meal times
services: Emergency shelter for men and for women/children|Public soup kitchen|Free clothing closet|Case management|Referrals to self-sufficiency resources

name: Dothan Rescue Mission
description: Dothan Rescue Mission has provided lifelines to people experiencing homelessness in the Wiregrass since 1979, delivering more than 15,000 meals and 12,000 nights of shelter each year through separate men's and family lodges. Guests receive hot food, clean clothing, and temporary shelter alongside case support aimed at helping them rebuild toward stable housing, serving Houston, Coffee, Dale, Geneva, and Henry counties in southeast Alabama.
description_es: Dothan Rescue Mission ha ofrecido salvavidas a personas sin hogar en la región Wiregrass desde 1979, entregando más de 15,000 comidas y 12,000 noches de refugio al año a través de albergues separados para hombres y familias. Los huéspedes reciben comida caliente, ropa limpia y refugio temporal junto con apoyo de caso para ayudarlos a reconstruir una vivienda estable, sirviendo a los condados de Houston, Coffee, Dale, Geneva y Henry en el sureste de Alabama.
eligibility: Men, women, and families experiencing homelessness in the Wiregrass region; call ahead for shelter and meal availability; men's shelter at 211 East Washington Street and family shelter at 209 East Washington Street.
eligibility_es: Hombres, mujeres y familias sin hogar en la región Wiregrass; llame con anticipación para disponibilidad de refugio y comidas; refugio de hombres en 211 East Washington Street y refugio familiar en 209 East Washington Street.
notes: Administrative office hours are Monday–Thursday 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m. and Friday 8:30 a.m.–noon; meals are served daily near noon and again in the late afternoon; call first to confirm current shelter space.
notes_es: El horario de la oficina administrativa es de lunes a jueves de 8:30 a.m. a 4:00 p.m. y viernes de 8:30 a.m. a mediodía; las comidas se sirven diariamente cerca del mediodía y de nuevo por la tarde; llame primero para confirmar espacio de refugio.
hours: Administrative office Monday–Thursday, 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Friday, 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
services: Emergency shelter for men and families|Daily hot meals|Clothing assistance|Case support|Community referrals

name: Downtown Rescue Mission
description: Downtown Rescue Mission has served men, women, and children across North Alabama and South Tennessee for more than 50 years with emergency shelter, daily meals, and a work-and-social-rehabilitation therapy program. Separate dorms exist for men and for women, including women with children, and the year-long, faith-based Life Recovery Program combines biblical education, counseling, life-skills training, and job-readiness preparation for adults whose homelessness is tied to substance use.
description_es: Downtown Rescue Mission ha servido a hombres, mujeres y niños del norte de Alabama y sur de Tennessee por más de 50 años con refugio de emergencia, comidas diarias y un programa de rehabilitación laboral y social. Existen dormitorios separados para hombres y para mujeres, incluidas mujeres con niños, y el programa Life Recovery de un año, basado en la fe, combina educación bíblica, asesoría, capacitación en habilidades de vida y preparación laboral para adultos cuya falta de vivienda está ligada al uso de sustancias.
eligibility: Men, women, and families experiencing homelessness in the Huntsville/Madison County area; emergency shelter available on a walk-in basis; the Life Recovery Program requires an intake interview and roughly one-year residential commitment.
eligibility_es: Hombres, mujeres y familias sin hogar en el área de Huntsville/Madison; refugio de emergencia disponible sin cita previa; el programa Life Recovery requiere una entrevista de admisión y un compromiso residencial de aproximadamente un año.
notes: Office hours are Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; call 256-536-2441 for shelter intake or to schedule a tour; single fathers and single mothers each have dedicated shelter tracks.
notes_es: El horario de oficina es de lunes a viernes, 8:30 a.m. a 4:30 p.m.; llame al 256-536-2441 para admisión al refugio o para programar una visita; hay vías de refugio dedicadas para padres solteros y madres solteras.
hours: Shelter 24/7; administrative office Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: Emergency shelter for men, women, and families|Year-long Life Recovery Program|Daily meals|Work and social rehabilitation therapy|Counseling

name: Christ Health Center — Woodlawn
description: Christ Health Center is a Federally Qualified Health Center network serving more than 18,000 patients a year across four Birmingham locations, offering pediatric and adult medical care, dental services, pharmacy, and mental health counseling. The Woodlawn location provides medical and dental care on a sliding fee scale, accepting most insurance as well as patients with limited or no coverage, and integrates mental health visits into primary care for returning residents rebuilding stability.
description_es: Christ Health Center es una red de Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente que atiende a más de 18,000 pacientes al año en cuatro ubicaciones de Birmingham, ofreciendo atención médica pediátrica y de adultos, servicios dentales, farmacia y asesoría de salud mental. La ubicación de Woodlawn ofrece atención médica y dental en escala móvil, aceptando la mayoría de los seguros y también a pacientes con cobertura limitada o sin ella.
eligibility: Children, adults, and families in the Birmingham area regardless of insurance status; sliding fee scale available based on household income; most major insurance plans and Medicaid accepted.
eligibility_es: Niños, adultos y familias en el área de Birmingham sin importar el estado del seguro; escala móvil de tarifas disponible según ingresos del hogar; se acepta la mayoría de los seguros y Medicaid.
notes: Call 205-380-9455 to schedule at Woodlawn; dental appointments call 205-380-9446; pharmacy is at 205-380-9450; additional Chalkville and Live Oaks locations and a pediatric clinic operate elsewhere in Birmingham.
notes_es: Llame al 205-380-9455 para programar una cita en Woodlawn; para citas dentales llame al 205-380-9446; la farmacia está en el 205-380-9450; hay ubicaciones adicionales en Chalkville y Live Oaks y una clínica pediátrica en otras partes de Birmingham.
hours: Medical and dental clinic hours vary by location; call to confirm
services: Primary medical care|Dental care|Pharmacy|Mental health counseling|Sliding-scale fees

name: Alabama Regional Medical Services (ARMS)
description: Alabama Regional Medical Services, formerly known as Birmingham Health Care, has served the greater Birmingham area since 1985 as a HRSA-funded community health center offering urgent, acute, and primary care to the underserved, uninsured, and homeless. ARMS operates a Certified Primary Care Medical Home model across several neighborhood health centers plus the CrossRoads to Intervention program, giving returning residents a stable medical home regardless of ability to pay.
description_es: Alabama Regional Medical Services, antes conocido como Birmingham Health Care, ha servido al área metropolitana de Birmingham desde 1985 como un centro de salud comunitario financiado por HRSA que ofrece atención urgente, aguda y primaria a personas desatendidas, sin seguro y sin hogar. ARMS opera un modelo de Hogar Médico de Atención Primaria Certificado en varios centros de salud vecinales, brindando a las personas en reinserción un hogar médico estable sin importar su capacidad de pago.
eligibility: Underserved, uninsured, under-insured, low-income, and homeless individuals and families in the Birmingham area; sliding fee scale based on income; walk-ins accepted at most sites.
eligibility_es: Personas y familias desatendidas, sin seguro, con seguro insuficiente, de bajos ingresos y sin hogar en el área de Birmingham; escala móvil de tarifas según ingresos; se aceptan pacientes sin cita en la mayoría de los sitios.
notes: Call the corporate office at 205-407-6900 for site information; the Metro Health Center is at 712 25th Street North and the Northern Health Center at 2817 30th Avenue North; ARMS is JCAHCO accredited and a legacy member of the National Health Care for the Homeless Council.
notes_es: Llame a la oficina corporativa al 205-407-6900 para información de sedes; el Metro Health Center está en 712 25th Street North y el Northern Health Center en 2817 30th Avenue North; ARMS está acreditado por JCAHCO y es miembro histórico del National Health Care for the Homeless Council.
hours: Clinic hours vary by site; call for current schedule
services: Urgent and primary care|Acute care|Certified Primary Care Medical Home|Homeless health services|CrossRoads to Intervention

name: Whatley Health Services — Maude L. Whatley Health Center
description: Whatley Health Services is a Federally Qualified Health Center headquartered in Tuscaloosa that provides primary medical and dental care, behavioral health, and STD/HIV testing to residents of West Alabama regardless of insurance status. Since receiving New Access Point funding in 2007 to serve homeless individuals and at-risk children, Whatley has grown to ten locations across Tuscaloosa, Greene, Hale, Pickens, Sumter, Fayette, Lamar, and surrounding counties, plus a mobile health unit.
description_es: Whatley Health Services es un Centro de Salud Calificado Federalmente con sede en Tuscaloosa que ofrece atención médica y dental primaria, salud conductual y pruebas de VIH/ETS a residentes del oeste de Alabama sin importar el seguro. Desde que recibió fondos en 2007 para servir a personas sin hogar y niños en riesgo, Whatley ha crecido a diez ubicaciones en los condados de Tuscaloosa, Greene, Hale, Pickens, Sumter, Fayette, Lamar y alrededores, además de una unidad médica móvil.
eligibility: Children, adults, and seniors in West Alabama with private insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, Tricare, or no insurance; sliding fee schedule available for those who meet household size and income guidelines.
eligibility_es: Niños, adultos y personas mayores del oeste de Alabama con seguro privado, Medicare, Medicaid, Tricare o sin seguro; escala móvil de tarifas disponible para quienes cumplan las pautas de tamaño de hogar e ingresos.
notes: Call 205-758-6647 to schedule at the main Tuscaloosa location, open Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–8 p.m. and Saturday 8 a.m.–3 p.m.; satellite clinics operate in Eutaw, Vernon, Carrollton, Livingston, and Sipsey with local phone numbers.
notes_es: Llame al 205-758-6647 para programar en la ubicación principal de Tuscaloosa, abierta de lunes a viernes de 8 a.m. a 8 p.m. y sábado de 8 a.m. a 3 p.m.; hay clínicas satélite en Eutaw, Vernon, Carrollton, Livingston y Sipsey con números locales.
hours: Main location Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.; Saturday, 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
services: Primary medical care|Dental care|Behavioral health|STD/HIV testing|Mobile health unit

name: Franklin Primary Health Center
description: Franklin Primary Health Center is a Federally Qualified Health Center anchored by the Franklin Medical Mall in downtown Mobile, delivering primary care, dental, vision, pediatrics, women's health, and behavioral health to Southwest Alabama regardless of ability to pay. The network operates additional sites in Prichard, Brewton, Evergreen, Bay Minette, Foley, and Loxley, giving returning residents across the Mobile Bay region a consistent medical home and integrated behavioral health support.
description_es: Franklin Primary Health Center es un Centro de Salud Calificado Federalmente anclado por el Franklin Medical Mall en el centro de Mobile, que ofrece atención primaria, dental, de la vista, pediátrica, de la mujer y conductual al suroeste de Alabama sin importar la capacidad de pago. La red opera sitios adicionales en Prichard, Brewton, Evergreen, Bay Minette, Foley y Loxley.
address: 1303 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue
eligibility: Individuals and families in Southwest Alabama regardless of income or insurance status; sliding fee scale available; most insurance plans, Medicaid, and Medicare accepted.
eligibility_es: Personas y familias del suroeste de Alabama sin importar ingresos o estado del seguro; escala móvil de tarifas disponible; se acepta la mayoría de los seguros, Medicaid y Medicare.
notes: Call 251-432-4117 to schedule at the Franklin Medical Mall or any satellite site; the Medical & Dental Express and Wellness, Smiles & Vision Express operate at the same downtown Mobile address for same-day needs.
notes_es: Llame al 251-432-4117 para programar en el Franklin Medical Mall o en cualquier sitio satélite; el Medical & Dental Express y Wellness, Smiles & Vision Express operan en la misma dirección del centro de Mobile para necesidades el mismo día.
hours: Clinic hours vary by site; call for current schedule
services: Primary medical care|Dental care|Vision care|Behavioral health|Women's and pediatric health

name: Thrive Alabama
description: Thrive Alabama, formerly the Davis Clinic, is a Ryan White Part B and C medical provider delivering HIV primary care, prevention, and case management from its Huntsville hub with a satellite clinic in Florence. Services include medical visits, medication access, PrEP, non-medical case management, and mental health support for people living with or at risk for HIV across North Alabama, an important continuity-of-care resource for people leaving incarceration with HIV-related health needs.
description_es: Thrive Alabama, antes Davis Clinic, es un proveedor médico Ryan White Parte B y C que ofrece atención primaria de VIH, prevención y manejo de caso desde su sede en Huntsville, con una clínica satélite en Florence. Los servicios incluyen visitas médicas, acceso a medicamentos, PrEP, manejo de caso no médico y apoyo de salud mental para personas que viven con o en riesgo de VIH en el norte de Alabama.
eligibility: People living with HIV or at risk of HIV in North Alabama; Ryan White eligibility screening required for some services; income-based sliding scale; toll-free line 800-728-3603.
eligibility_es: Personas que viven con VIH o en riesgo de VIH en el norte de Alabama; se requiere evaluación de elegibilidad Ryan White para algunos servicios; escala móvil según ingresos; línea gratuita 800-728-3603.
notes: Call 256-536-4700 for the Huntsville Davis Clinic or 256-764-0492 for the Florence Hames Clinic satellite office at 112 South Pine Street; an Albertville satellite also serves Marshall County.
notes_es: Llame al 256-536-4700 para la Davis Clinic en Huntsville o al 256-764-0492 para la oficina satélite Hames Clinic en Florence, 112 South Pine Street; una sede satélite en Albertville también atiende al condado de Marshall.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours; call to confirm current schedule
services: HIV primary medical care|Prevention and PrEP|Non-medical case management|Medication access|Mental health support

name: Birmingham AIDS Outreach (BAO)
description: Birmingham AIDS Outreach provides free, confidential HIV and STI testing, medical case management, mental health counseling, and support groups for people living with or affected by HIV in Central Alabama. BAO is the only AIDS service organization in Alabama offering free legal services for HIV-positive clients, handling estate planning, custody, and discrimination cases, and its social workers help clients navigate healthcare, transportation, and referrals with limited income or no insurance.
description_es: Birmingham AIDS Outreach ofrece pruebas gratuitas y confidenciales de VIH e ITS, manejo de caso médico, asesoría de salud mental y grupos de apoyo para personas que viven con o afectadas por el VIH en el centro de Alabama. BAO es la única organización de servicios de SIDA en Alabama que ofrece servicios legales gratuitos para clientes VIH positivos, manejando planificación patrimonial, custodia y casos de discriminación.
eligibility: People living with or affected by HIV in Central Alabama; free HIV/STI testing open to all; case management and legal services prioritized for HIV-positive clients meeting program eligibility.
eligibility_es: Personas que viven con o afectadas por el VIH en el centro de Alabama; pruebas gratuitas de VIH/ITS abiertas a todos; manejo de caso y servicios legales priorizados para clientes VIH positivos que cumplan los requisitos del programa.
notes: Walk-in service hours are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday 9:00–11:45 a.m. and 12:30–5:00 p.m., and Friday 9:00 a.m.–noon; transportation assistance is available once per week for clients with recent appointments.
notes_es: El horario de servicio sin cita es lunes, martes y jueves de 9:00 a 11:45 a.m. y de 12:30 a 5:00 p.m., y viernes de 9:00 a.m. a mediodía; hay asistencia de transporte disponible una vez por semana para clientes con citas recientes.
hours: Walk-in hours Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Friday, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
services: Free HIV/STI testing|Medical case management|Legal services for HIV-positive clients|Mental health counseling and support groups|Transportation assistance

name: Riverbend Center for Mental Health
description: Riverbend Center for Mental Health has provided mental health, substance use, and psychiatric services to Northwest Alabama since 1950, serving more than 7,500 clients a year across Colbert, Franklin, and Lauderdale counties. Programs include adult case management, intensive day treatment, partial hospitalization, residential services, and certified peer specialist support, with emergency services and outpatient commitments handled through the Florence facility.
description_es: Riverbend Center for Mental Health ha ofrecido servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias y psiquiatría al noroeste de Alabama desde 1950, sirviendo a más de 7,500 clientes al año en los condados de Colbert, Franklin y Lauderdale. Los programas incluyen manejo de caso para adultos, tratamiento diurno intensivo, hospitalización parcial, servicios residenciales y apoyo de especialistas de pares certificados.
eligibility: Residents of Colbert, Franklin, and Lauderdale counties needing mental health or substance use treatment; call to schedule an intake assessment; a family member may call to initiate the process if the individual cannot.
eligibility_es: Residentes de los condados de Colbert, Franklin y Lauderdale que necesitan tratamiento de salud mental o uso de sustancias; llame para programar una evaluación de admisión; un familiar puede llamar para iniciar el proceso si la persona no puede.
notes: Call 256-764-3431 to schedule an Intake Assessment; the same number serves as the After Hours/Emergency line; a second facility in Russellville at 205 S. Jackson Avenue serves Franklin County clients.
notes_es: Llame al 256-764-3431 para programar una evaluación de admisión; el mismo número sirve como línea de emergencia fuera de horario; una segunda instalación en Russellville, 205 S. Jackson Avenue, atiende a clientes del condado de Franklin.
hours: Outpatient office Monday–Friday business hours; emergency line available after hours
services: Adult and child mental health case management|Substance use treatment|Intensive day treatment|Residential services|Certified peer specialist support

name: The Foundry Ministries — Recovery Program
description: The Foundry Ministries runs Christ-centered residential addiction recovery in Bessemer for men and women, plus a Rescue Program serving Birmingham's chronically homeless with long-term transitional housing, financial literacy, and help obtaining missing or expired identification. The program blends spiritual guidance, counseling, and job-readiness training with a thrift-store work-therapy track for addicts and ex-inmates rebuilding stable lives.
description_es: The Foundry Ministries opera recuperación residencial de adicciones centrada en Cristo en Bessemer para hombres y mujeres, además de un Programa de Rescate para personas sin hogar crónicas de Birmingham con vivienda de transición a largo plazo, educación financiera y ayuda para obtener identificación perdida o vencida. El programa combina orientación espiritual, asesoría y capacitación laboral con una vía de terapia de trabajo en tiendas de segunda mano.
eligibility: Men and women struggling with addiction, including people recently released from incarceration; Women's Center is at 1800 4th Avenue North, Bessemer; apply through the website or call the Men's Center.
eligibility_es: Hombres y mujeres que luchan contra la adicción, incluidas personas recién liberadas de la encarcelación; el Centro de Mujeres está en 1800 4th Avenue North, Bessemer; solicite a través del sitio web o llame al Centro de Hombres.
notes: Call 205-428-8449 for the Men's Center or 205-425-7737 for the Women's Center; The Foundry Farm in Cullman offers a rural setting for men; aftercare and thrift-store employment readiness continue after graduation.
notes_es: Llame al 205-428-8449 para el Centro de Hombres o al 205-425-7737 para el Centro de Mujeres; The Foundry Farm en Cullman ofrece un entorno rural para hombres; el cuidado posterior y la preparación laboral en tiendas continúan después de graduarse.
hours: Residential program 24/7; office calls Monday–Friday business hours
services: Residential addiction recovery for men and women|Rescue Program transitional housing|Financial literacy classes|ID document assistance|Job-readiness thrift-store training

name: Aletheia House
description: Aletheia House is one of Alabama's most established substance use treatment and reentry providers, offering transitional housing, case management, and recovery support for justice-involved individuals in Birmingham with direct referral access from the Alabama Department of Corrections. Services include drug and alcohol treatment, women's programming, HIV services, and affordable housing, with average stays of 90 to 180 days and intake accepted from courts, probation, or self-referral.
description_es: Aletheia House es uno de los proveedores de tratamiento de uso de sustancias y reinserción más establecidos de Alabama, ofreciendo vivienda de transición, manejo de caso y apoyo de recuperación para personas involucradas en el sistema judicial en Birmingham, con acceso directo de referencia del Departamento de Correcciones de Alabama. Los servicios incluyen tratamiento de drogas y alcohol, programación para mujeres, servicios de VIH y vivienda asequible, con estadías promedio de 90 a 180 días.
eligibility: Adults with substance use disorders, including people involved with the justice system; referrals accepted from courts, probation and parole officers, or by self-referral; intake available year-round.
eligibility_es: Adultos con trastornos por uso de sustancias, incluidas personas involucradas con el sistema judicial; se aceptan referencias de tribunales, oficiales de probatoria y libertad condicional, o por autorreferencia; admisión disponible todo el año.
notes: Call 205-324-6502 for intake information at the Jefferson County location; the Jobs for Vets program operates separately at 2631 Ensley 5 Point West Avenue, 205-588-0597, for veterans needing employment support.
notes_es: Llame al 205-324-6502 para información de admisión en la ubicación del condado de Jefferson; el programa Jobs for Vets opera por separado en 2631 Ensley 5 Point West Avenue, 205-588-0597, para veteranos que necesitan apoyo de empleo.
hours: Office Monday–Friday business hours; residential programs 24/7
services: Substance use treatment|Transitional housing|Case management|Employment assistance|HIV services

name: Fellowship House
description: Fellowship House has served people with alcoholism, drug addiction, and co-occurring mental health disorders in Birmingham for more than 60 years, offering a full continuum of care from residential treatment through transitional apartments to outpatient services. The 73-capacity program uses a sliding fee scale, requires an ASAM assessment for admission, and runs a Family Program with counseling, events, and group therapy to help rebuild relationships strained by addiction and incarceration.
description_es: Fellowship House ha servido a personas con alcoholismo, adicción a drogas y trastornos concurrentes de salud mental en Birmingham por más de 60 años, ofreciendo un continuo completo de atención desde tratamiento residencial hasta apartamentos de transición y servicios ambulatorios. El programa, con capacidad para 73 personas, usa escala móvil de tarifas, requiere una evaluación ASAM para la admisión y ofrece un Programa Familiar con asesoría, eventos y terapia de grupo.
eligibility: Adult men and women with alcoholism, drug addiction, or co-occurring mental health disorders; an American Society of Addiction Medicine assessment is required; sliding-scale fees based on ability to pay.
eligibility_es: Hombres y mujeres adultos con alcoholismo, adicción a drogas o trastornos concurrentes de salud mental; se requiere una evaluación de la Sociedad Americana de Medicina de Adicciones; tarifas en escala móvil según la capacidad de pago.
notes: Contact the intake department at intake@fshbhm.org or 205-933-2430 extension 1402; if this is a medical emergency call 911; residential, transitional apartment, and outpatient tracks are available depending on need.
notes_es: Contacte al departamento de admisión en intake@fshbhm.org o al 205-933-2430 extensión 1402; si es una emergencia médica llame al 911; hay vías residenciales, de apartamentos de transición y ambulatorias según la necesidad.
hours: Irregular; call for intake appointment details
services: Residential addiction treatment|Transitional apartments|Outpatient treatment|Family Program counseling|Co-occurring disorder care

name: The Lovelady Center
description: The Lovelady Center is the nation's largest long-term, Christ-centered recovery program dedicated to women and their children, serving women displaced by addiction, incarceration, domestic violence, and homelessness at no cost to clients. Recognized as a national model, the Center delivers comprehensive wraparound services including addiction counseling, parenting support, job training, and on-site housing so mothers can recover alongside their children rather than being separated from them.
description_es: The Lovelady Center es el programa de recuperación a largo plazo centrado en Cristo más grande del país dedicado a mujeres y sus hijos, sirviendo a mujeres desplazadas por la adicción, encarcelación, violencia doméstica y falta de vivienda sin costo para las clientas. Reconocido como un modelo nacional, el Centro ofrece servicios integrales que incluyen asesoría de adicciones, apoyo de crianza, capacitación laboral y vivienda en el lugar para que las madres se recuperen junto a sus hijos.
eligibility: Women displaced by addiction, incarceration, domestic violence, or homelessness, including women with children; program is free of charge; apply through the website's admissions form.
eligibility_es: Mujeres desplazadas por la adicción, encarcelación, violencia doméstica o falta de vivienda, incluidas mujeres con niños; el programa es gratuito; solicite a través del formulario de admisión del sitio web.
notes: Call the main line at 205-833-7410 for admissions and program questions; women may bring their children to live on campus during treatment; two Lovelady Thrift stores in Irondale and Clay support the program.
notes_es: Llame a la línea principal al 205-833-7410 para preguntas de admisión y del programa; las mujeres pueden llevar a sus hijos a vivir en el campus durante el tratamiento; dos tiendas Lovelady Thrift en Irondale y Clay apoyan al programa.
hours: Residential program 24/7; office calls Monday–Friday business hours
services: Long-term residential recovery for women|On-site housing for mothers and children|Addiction counseling|Parenting support|Job training

name: WellStone — Access to Care
description: WellStone provides comprehensive mental health and substance use treatment across North Alabama, with no one turned away for inability to pay and most insurance including Medicaid and Tricare accepted. The Huntsville campus offers individual, group, and intensive outpatient therapy plus medication management, while WellStone Emergency Services provides 24/7 walk-in crisis stabilization and mobile crisis teams for adults and children facing a mental health or substance use emergency.
description_es: WellStone ofrece tratamiento integral de salud mental y uso de sustancias en el norte de Alabama, sin rechazar a nadie por incapacidad de pago y aceptando la mayoría de los seguros, incluidos Medicaid y Tricare. El campus de Huntsville ofrece terapia individual, grupal e intensiva ambulatoria además de manejo de medicamentos, mientras que WellStone Emergency Services ofrece estabilización de crisis las 24 horas y equipos móviles de crisis.
eligibility: Adults and children in North Alabama needing mental health or substance use treatment; no one is turned away for inability to pay; call the Access to Care line to register for services.
eligibility_es: Adultos y niños en el norte de Alabama que necesitan tratamiento de salud mental o uso de sustancias; a nadie se le niega el servicio por incapacidad de pago; llame a la línea de Acceso a la Atención para registrarse.
notes: Call the Huntsville Access to Care line at 256-705-6444 (Spanish 256-475-0776); WellStone Emergency Services at 4020 Memorial Parkway SW accepts walk-ins day or night; adult mobile crisis team 256-947-2065.
notes_es: Llame a la línea de Acceso a la Atención de Huntsville al 256-705-6444 (español 256-475-0776); WellStone Emergency Services en 4020 Memorial Parkway SW acepta pacientes sin cita día y noche; equipo móvil de crisis para adultos 256-947-2065.
hours: Outpatient campus Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Emergency Services 24/7 walk-in
services: Individual and group substance use therapy|Intensive outpatient programs|24/7 crisis stabilization|Mobile crisis teams|Medication management

name: Offender Alumni Association
description: The Offender Alumni Association is a peer-led nonprofit founded and staffed by formerly incarcerated individuals who provide reentry navigation, mentorship, and violence-intervention support in Birmingham. Reentry Navigators help returning citizens access housing, employment, mental health care, and life skills, while OAA also runs family reunification support and parenting programs, building a network of credible messengers who mentor people coming home from incarceration.
description_es: Offender Alumni Association es una organización sin fines de lucro liderada por personas anteriormente encarceladas que brindan navegación de reinserción, mentoría y apoyo de intervención de violencia en Birmingham. Los Navegadores de Reinserción ayudan a los ciudadanos que regresan a acceder a vivienda, empleo, atención de salud mental y habilidades de vida, mientras OAA también ofrece apoyo de reunificación familiar y programas de crianza.
eligibility: Formerly incarcerated individuals and their families in the Birmingham area seeking peer mentorship and reentry navigation; open forums provide a safe space to connect with staff who have lived experience.
eligibility_es: Personas anteriormente encarceladas y sus familias en el área de Birmingham que buscan mentoría de pares y navegación de reinserción; los foros abiertos ofrecen un espacio seguro para conectar con personal que tiene experiencia vivida.
notes: Call 205-224-4138 or visit the website to connect with a Reentry Navigator; OAA staff are trained in trauma-informed, de-escalation approaches and can support families dealing with incarceration or violence.
notes_es: Llame al 205-224-4138 o visite el sitio web para conectarse con un Navegador de Reinserción; el personal de OAA está capacitado en enfoques informados sobre el trauma y de desescalada, y puede apoyar a familias que enfrentan encarcelación o violencia.
hours: Office hours vary; call for current schedule
services: Peer-led reentry navigation|Mentorship from formerly incarcerated staff|Family reunification support|Parenting programs|Violence intervention

name: Wings Across Alabama — Alabama Warm Line
description: Wings Across Alabama is the state's largest mental health consumer-run organization, offering peer support through certified peer specialists who share lived experience with mental illness and recovery. The statewide Alabama Warm Line connects callers with a trained peer 24 hours a day for non-crisis emotional support, a valuable resource for people leaving incarceration who need someone who understands recovery to talk to outside of clinical or crisis settings.
description_es: Wings Across Alabama es la organización de consumidores de salud mental más grande del estado, dirigida por personas con experiencia vivida en enfermedad mental y recuperación. La Alabama Warm Line estatal conecta a quienes llaman con un par capacitado las 24 horas del día para apoyo emocional sin crisis, un recurso valioso para personas que salen de la encarcelación y necesitan hablar con alguien que entiende la recuperación.
eligibility: Anyone in Alabama seeking non-crisis peer emotional support; the Warm Line is not a crisis line—callers in immediate crisis should call or text 988; office inquiries call the Wings office line.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona en Alabama que busque apoyo emocional de pares sin crisis; la Warm Line no es una línea de crisis—quienes estén en crisis inmediata deben llamar o enviar un mensaje de texto al 988; para consultas de oficina llame a la línea de Wings.
notes: Call the Alabama Warm Line at 844-999-4647, available 24/7; for organizational inquiries or Certified Peer Specialist training information call the Wings office at 334-649-1339.
notes_es: Llame a la Alabama Warm Line al 844-999-4647, disponible las 24 horas; para consultas organizacionales o información de capacitación de Especialista de Pares Certificado llame a la oficina de Wings al 334-649-1339.
services: 24/7 peer support warm line|Certified Peer Specialist training|Mental health recovery support|Community peer programs

name: Community Action Partnership Huntsville/Madison & Limestone Counties
description: Community Action Partnership Huntsville/Madison & Limestone Counties helps low-income households meet immediate needs through the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, weatherization, and family support services from its central Huntsville office and neighborhood satellite sites. LIHEAP-eligible households can receive help with heating and cooling bills, with additional crisis assistance available for households with elderly members, people with disabilities, or children age 18 and younger.
description_es: Community Action Partnership Huntsville/Madison & Limestone Counties ayuda a los hogares de bajos ingresos a cubrir necesidades inmediatas a través del Programa de Asistencia de Energía para Hogares de Bajos Ingresos, climatización y servicios de apoyo familiar desde su oficina central en Huntsville y sitios satélite vecinales. Los hogares elegibles para LIHEAP pueden recibir ayuda con facturas de calefacción y aire acondicionado, con asistencia de crisis adicional disponible para hogares con miembros mayores, personas con discapacidades o niños de 18 años o menos.
eligibility: Low-income households in Madison and Limestone counties; income guidelines apply for LIHEAP energy assistance; one regular heating and one regular cooling payment allowed per year, plus crisis assistance if funding allows.
eligibility_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Madison y Limestone; aplican pautas de ingresos para la asistencia energética LIHEAP; se permite un pago regular de calefacción y uno de aire acondicionado por año, más asistencia de crisis si hay fondos disponibles.
notes: Schedule an appointment through the automated scheduler at 256-907-1550 or call the main office at 256-851-9800; satellite locations serve Ardmore, Athens, Madison/Triana, New Hope, and New Market.
notes_es: Programe una cita a través del sistema automatizado al 256-907-1550 o llame a la oficina principal al 256-851-9800; hay sitios satélite en Ardmore, Athens, Madison/Triana, New Hope y New Market.
services: Home energy bill assistance|Weatherization|Crisis utility assistance|Family support referrals

name: Community Service Programs of West Alabama
description: Community Service Programs of West Alabama provides resources that resolve immediate needs and build long-term self-sufficiency for low-income and vulnerable residents of ten West Alabama counties, administering energy assistance, food resources, and senior services from its Tuscaloosa headquarters. A dedicated call center connects households to available programs, with additional support for clients age 60 and older through a separate senior services line.
description_es: Community Service Programs of West Alabama proporciona recursos que resuelven necesidades inmediatas y desarrollan autosuficiencia a largo plazo para residentes de bajos ingresos y vulnerables en diez condados del oeste de Alabama, administrando asistencia energética, recursos alimentarios y servicios para personas mayores desde su sede en Tuscaloosa. Un centro de llamadas dedicado conecta a los hogares con los programas disponibles.
eligibility: Low-income and vulnerable households in Bibb, Choctaw, Dallas, Fayette, Greene, Hale, Lamar, Perry, Sumter, and Tuscaloosa counties; income guidelines apply for most assistance programs.
eligibility_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos y vulnerables en los condados de Bibb, Choctaw, Dallas, Fayette, Greene, Hale, Lamar, Perry, Sumter y Tuscaloosa; aplican pautas de ingresos para la mayoría de los programas de asistencia.
notes: Call the general call center at 833-836-7817 or the main office at 205-752-5429; clients age 60 and older can call 205-469-0386 for senior-specific services.
notes_es: Llame al centro de llamadas general al 833-836-7817 o a la oficina principal al 205-752-5429; los clientes de 60 años o más pueden llamar al 205-469-0386 para servicios específicos para personas mayores.
services: Energy and utility assistance|Food resources|Senior services|Self-sufficiency case management

name: Southeast Alabama Community Action Partnership (SEACAP)
description: Southeast Alabama Community Action Partnership is the Community Action Agency for the Wiregrass, providing utility assistance, weatherization, and family self-sufficiency programs from offices across Barbour, Coffee, Geneva, Henry, and Houston counties. The Dothan office serves Houston County residents directly, connecting returning residents and low-income families to energy assistance and referrals for food, housing, and other basic needs.
description_es: Southeast Alabama Community Action Partnership es la Agencia de Acción Comunitaria de la región Wiregrass, que ofrece asistencia de servicios públicos, climatización y programas de autosuficiencia familiar desde oficinas en los condados de Barbour, Coffee, Geneva, Henry y Houston. La oficina de Dothan atiende directamente a los residentes del condado de Houston, conectando a residentes en reinserción y familias de bajos ingresos con asistencia energética y referencias.
eligibility: Low-income households in Barbour, Coffee, Geneva, Henry, and Houston counties; income guidelines apply for utility assistance and weatherization programs.
eligibility_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Barbour, Coffee, Geneva, Henry y Houston; aplican pautas de ingresos para programas de asistencia de servicios públicos y climatización.
notes: Call the Dothan office at 334-794-8754; the main SEACAP administrative office is in Enterprise at 100 George Wallace Drive, 334-347-0881; additional county offices operate in Eufaula, Elba, Hartford, and Abbeville.
notes_es: Llame a la oficina de Dothan al 334-794-8754; la oficina administrativa principal de SEACAP está en Enterprise, 100 George Wallace Drive, 334-347-0881; hay oficinas adicionales en Eufaula, Elba, Hartford y Abbeville.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours; call to confirm
services: Utility and energy assistance|Weatherization|Family self-sufficiency programs|Referrals to food and housing resources

name: Community Action Agency of South Alabama
description: Community Action Agency of South Alabama promotes self-sufficiency for individuals, families, and communities across seven rural Southwest Alabama counties from its Daphne headquarters, administering energy assistance, weatherization, and Head Start alongside referrals for food and housing. The agency's call center helps low-income and returning residents in Baldwin, Escambia, Conecuh, Monroe, Clarke, Marengo, and Wilcox counties connect to available benefits.
description_es: Community Action Agency of South Alabama promueve la autosuficiencia de personas, familias y comunidades en siete condados rurales del suroeste de Alabama desde su sede en Daphne, administrando asistencia energética, climatización y Head Start junto con referencias para alimentos y vivienda. El centro de llamadas de la agencia ayuda a residentes de bajos ingresos fuera del condado de Mobile propiamente dicho.
eligibility: Low-income residents of Baldwin, Clarke, Conecuh, Escambia, Marengo, Monroe, and Wilcox counties; income guidelines apply for energy assistance and other programs.
eligibility_es: Residentes de bajos ingresos de los condados de Baldwin, Clarke, Conecuh, Escambia, Marengo, Monroe y Wilcox; aplican pautas de ingresos para la asistencia energética y otros programas.
notes: Call the central office at 251-626-2646 or the call center at 877-246-7836; check the website for Outreach Office and Head Start Center locations closest to you.
notes_es: Llame a la oficina central al 251-626-2646 o al centro de llamadas al 877-246-7836; consulte el sitio web para conocer las ubicaciones de la Oficina de Alcance y los Centros Head Start más cercanos.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours; call to confirm
services: Energy and utility assistance|Weatherization|Head Start early childhood services|Referrals to food and housing resources

name: Aid to Inmate Mothers
description: Aid to Inmate Mothers strengthens the bonds between Alabama's incarcerated women and their children through monthly facilitated visitation, the Storybook Project recorded-reading program, prison parenting classes, and family outreach for children affected by maternal incarceration. AIM's ARESET reentry program and Service Center for Women help mothers coming home reconnect with their children and access clothing, mentoring, and community referrals statewide.
description_es: Aid to Inmate Mothers fortalece los lazos entre las mujeres encarceladas de Alabama y sus hijos mediante visitas mensuales facilitadas, el programa Storybook Project de lectura grabada, clases de crianza en prisión y alcance familiar para niños afectados por la encarcelación materna. El programa de reinserción ARESET y el Centro de Servicio para Mujeres de AIM ayudan a las madres que regresan a reconectarse con sus hijos.
eligibility: Incarcerated women in Alabama prisons and their children or caregivers; reentry and Service Center for Women programs available to women returning home from incarceration.
eligibility_es: Mujeres encarceladas en las prisiones de Alabama y sus hijos o cuidadores; los programas de reinserción y el Centro de Servicio para Mujeres están disponibles para mujeres que regresan a casa de la encarcelación.
notes: Call the office at 334-262-2245 or the toll-free line at 800-679-0246; the Storybook Project records mothers reading books that are mailed to their children along with the book; Project Reconnect provides clothing for release.
notes_es: Llame a la oficina al 334-262-2245 o a la línea gratuita al 800-679-0246; el Storybook Project graba a las madres leyendo libros que se envían a sus hijos junto con el libro; Project Reconnect proporciona ropa para la liberación.
services: Facilitated prison visitation|Storybook Project reading recordings|Prison parenting classes|Reentry Service Center for Women|Clothing assistance

name: Tuscaloosa's One Place
description: Tuscaloosa's One Place is a family resource center that promotes self-sufficiency, strengthens families, and prevents child abuse and neglect for the Tuscaloosa community. One-on-one consultations during crisis or emergency situations connect families with holistic services matched to their needs, and the center partners with local agencies on programs like the Children's Policy Council and seasonal Holiday Heart campaigns to support families navigating hardship, including reentry.
description_es: Tuscaloosa's One Place es un centro de recursos familiares que promueve la autosuficiencia, fortalece a las familias y previene el abuso y negligencia infantil en la comunidad de Tuscaloosa. Las consultas individuales durante situaciones de crisis o emergencia conectan a las familias con servicios integrales adaptados a sus necesidades, y el centro colabora con agencias locales en programas de apoyo familiar.
eligibility: Families in the Tuscaloosa area facing crisis or emergency needs, including families affected by incarceration or reentry; intake assessments available for one-on-one consultation.
eligibility_es: Familias en el área de Tuscaloosa que enfrentan crisis o necesidades de emergencia, incluidas familias afectadas por la encarcelación o reinserción; evaluaciones de admisión disponibles para consulta individual.
notes: Call 205-462-1000 to schedule an intake assessment, available Monday–Friday 8:00 a.m.–noon; the Holiday Heart campaign helps families served throughout the year celebrate the holidays with donated gifts and clothing.
notes_es: Llame al 205-462-1000 para programar una evaluación de admisión, disponible de lunes a viernes de 8:00 a.m. a mediodía; la campaña Holiday Heart ayuda a las familias atendidas durante el año a celebrar las fiestas con regalos y ropa donados.
hours: Office Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; intake assessments 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
services: One-on-one crisis consultation|Family self-sufficiency resources|Child abuse and neglect prevention|Holiday assistance programs

name: Family Sunshine Center
description: Family Sunshine Center fosters hope and healing for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking across Central Alabama through crisis intervention, emergency shelter, and supportive services offered free of charge. The Exodus Community provides transitional housing for survivors working toward independence, with counseling, advocacy, and safety planning available through the 24/7 crisis line for families affected by a partner's incarceration.
description_es: Family Sunshine Center fomenta la esperanza y la sanación para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual y trata de personas en el centro de Alabama a través de intervención en crisis, refugio de emergencia y servicios de apoyo ofrecidos de forma gratuita. The Exodus Community ofrece vivienda de transición para sobrevivientes que trabajan hacia la independencia, con asesoría, defensa y planificación de seguridad disponibles las 24 horas.
eligibility: Survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, or human trafficking in Central Alabama and their children; services are free and confidential; call the crisis line or walk in during business hours.
eligibility_es: Sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual o trata de personas en el centro de Alabama y sus hijos; los servicios son gratuitos y confidenciales; llame a la línea de crisis o preséntese durante el horario de oficina.
notes: Call the 24/7 Crisis Resource Line at 334-263-0218 (collect calls accepted); walk-in services available at 858 South Court Street Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; call 911 if in immediate danger.
notes_es: Llame a la línea de crisis 24/7 al 334-263-0218 (se aceptan llamadas por cobrar); servicios sin cita disponibles en 858 South Court Street de lunes a viernes de 8:30 a.m. a 4:30 p.m.; llame al 911 si está en peligro inmediato.
hours: Crisis line 24/7; walk-in office Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: 24/7 crisis intervention|Emergency shelter and transitional housing|Counseling and advocacy|Safety planning|Human trafficking survivor support

name: Alabama DHR — Child Support Enforcement Division
description: The Alabama Department of Human Resources Child Support Enforcement Division helps families establish paternity, obtain child support orders, and enforce compliance through local departments in every county. Returning citizens with an existing child support order can request a review and adjustment based on changed circumstances such as incarceration or reduced income, an important step for avoiding arrears that build up during incarceration and complicate reentry.
description_es: La División de Cumplimiento de Manutención Infantil del Departamento de Servicios Humanos de Alabama ayuda a las familias a establecer la paternidad, obtener órdenes de manutención infantil y hacer cumplir el cumplimiento a través de departamentos locales en cada condado. Los ciudadanos que regresan con una orden de manutención existente pueden solicitar una revisión y ajuste según circunstancias cambiadas como la encarcelación o ingresos reducidos.
eligibility: Custodial and non-custodial parents statewide, including people returning from incarceration who need to modify a child support order; apply for services through your local county DHR office.
eligibility_es: Padres custodios y no custodios en todo el estado, incluidas personas que regresan de la encarcelación y necesitan modificar una orden de manutención infantil; solicite servicios a través de su oficina local de DHR del condado.
notes: Contact your local county Department of Human Resources office to request a child support order review; the Child Support Payment Center and online payment information are available at dhr.alabama.gov.
notes_es: Contacte a la oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos de su condado para solicitar una revisión de la orden de manutención infantil; el Centro de Pagos de Manutención Infantil y la información de pago en línea están disponibles en dhr.alabama.gov.
hours: Local DHR offices typically Monday–Friday business hours
services: Paternity establishment|Child support order establishment|Order review and modification|Enforcement and collection|Non-custodial parent location

name: BJCTA MAX Transit
description: MAX Transit, operated by the Birmingham-Jefferson County Transit Authority, provides fixed-route bus service, bus rapid transit, on-demand microtransit, and ADA paratransit throughout Birmingham-Jefferson County for a standard fare of $1.50 per trip. Reliable transportation is often a condition of employment, probation reporting, and treatment attendance, and MAX's transit centers plus the MAX Connect app help returning residents plan trips to jobs and appointments.
description_es: MAX Transit, operado por la Autoridad de Tránsito de Birmingham-Condado de Jefferson, ofrece servicio de autobús de ruta fija, tránsito rápido, microtránsito bajo demanda y paratránsito ADA en toda el área de Birmingham-Condado de Jefferson por una tarifa estándar de $1.50 por viaje. El transporte confiable suele ser una condición del empleo, los reportes de probatoria y la asistencia a tratamiento.
eligibility: General public in the Birmingham-Jefferson County area; ADA paratransit requires disability certification; passengers must have valid fare media before boarding.
eligibility_es: Público en general en el área de Birmingham-Condado de Jefferson; el paratránsito ADA requiere certificación de discapacidad; los pasajeros deben tener un medio de pago válido antes de abordar.
notes: Visit maxtransit.org or use the MAX Connect app to plan trips, buy passes, and track buses in real time; visit the Central, Crossplex, or Woodlawn Transit Centers to buy passes or get printed schedules.
notes_es: Visite maxtransit.org o use la aplicación MAX Connect para planificar viajes, comprar pases y rastrear autobuses en tiempo real; visite los Centros de Tránsito Central, Crossplex o Woodlawn para comprar pases u obtener horarios impresos.
hours: Service hours vary by route; see maxtransit.org for schedules
services: Fixed-route bus service|Bus rapid transit|On-demand microtransit|ADA paratransit|Trip planning app

name: The Wave Transit System
description: The Wave Transit System is Mobile's public bus service, offering fixed routes across the city along with a Mobility Assistance Program and a Customer Information Center to help riders plan trips. For returning residents in the Mobile area, reliable and affordable public transit supports getting to job interviews, treatment appointments, probation check-ins, and family court dates without depending on a personal vehicle.
description_es: The Wave Transit System es el servicio público de autobuses de Mobile, que ofrece rutas fijas por toda la ciudad junto con un Programa de Asistencia de Movilidad y un Centro de Información al Cliente para ayudar a los pasajeros a planificar viajes. Para las personas en reinserción en el área de Mobile, el transporte público confiable y asequible ayuda a llegar a entrevistas de trabajo, citas de tratamiento y reportes de probatoria.
eligibility: General public in the Mobile area; Mobility Assistance Program available for riders needing additional support; call for current fare and route information.
eligibility_es: Público en general en el área de Mobile; el Programa de Asistencia de Movilidad está disponible para pasajeros que necesitan apoyo adicional; llame para información actual de tarifas y rutas.
notes: Call 251-344-6600 or visit thewavetransit.com for route maps, schedules, and fare information; the Customer Information Center can help plan trips for job interviews or appointments.
notes_es: Llame al 251-344-6600 o visite thewavetransit.com para mapas de rutas, horarios e información de tarifas; el Centro de Información al Cliente puede ayudar a planificar viajes para entrevistas de trabajo o citas.
hours: Service hours vary by route; see thewavetransit.com for schedules
services: Fixed-route bus service|Mobility Assistance Program|Trip planning support|Customer information center

name: The Dannon Project
description: The Dannon Project is one of the nation's top-performing reentry employment organizations, helping unemployed and underemployed returning citizens and at-risk youth in Central Alabama build stable careers. Intensive case management begins up to six months before release, and short-term training in food service, building maintenance, office skills, and career pathways combined with GED testing has produced an estimated 96 percent job retention rate two years after graduation.
description_es: The Dannon Project es una de las organizaciones de empleo de reinserción de mejor desempeño del país, ayudando a ciudadanos que regresan desempleados o subempleados y a jóvenes en riesgo en el centro de Alabama a desarrollar carreras estables. El manejo de caso intensivo comienza hasta seis meses antes de la liberación, y la capacitación a corto plazo combinada con exámenes de GED ha producido una tasa estimada de retención laboral del 96 por ciento dos años después de la graduación.
eligibility: Unemployed or underemployed returning citizens, including people currently incarcerated within six months of release, and at-risk youth in Central Alabama; nonviolent offenders prioritized with limited exceptions.
eligibility_es: Ciudadanos que regresan desempleados o subempleados, incluidas personas actualmente encarceladas a menos de seis meses de su liberación, y jóvenes en riesgo en el centro de Alabama; se prioriza a delincuentes no violentos con excepciones limitadas.
notes: Call 205-202-4072 or visit dannonproject.org to apply; incarcerated individuals can begin case management before release through facility coordination; training includes ABE tutoring, GED testing, and career pathway counseling.
notes_es: Llame al 205-202-4072 o visite dannonproject.org para solicitar; las personas encarceladas pueden comenzar el manejo de caso antes de la liberación mediante coordinación con la instalación; la capacitación incluye tutoría ABE, exámenes de GED y asesoría de carrera.
services: Pre-release case management|Short-term job training and certifications|GED tutoring and testing|Job placement|Reentry case management

name: Alabama Goodwill Industries — Birmingham Career Center
description: Alabama Goodwill Industries operates a free Career Center offering job placement assistance, skills training, resume building, and career counseling for job seekers facing barriers to employment, including a criminal record. Employment specialists guide clients through every step of the job search, and Goodwill partners with local employers and the Birmingham Career Center on Second Chance hiring fairs specifically for people with felony or misdemeanor histories.
description_es: Alabama Goodwill Industries opera un Centro de Carrera gratuito que ofrece asistencia de colocación laboral, capacitación en habilidades, elaboración de currículums y asesoría de carrera para personas que buscan empleo y enfrentan barreras, incluido un historial penal. Los especialistas en empleo guían a los clientes en cada paso de la búsqueda de trabajo, y Goodwill se asocia con empleadores locales en ferias de contratación de segunda oportunidad específicamente para personas con antecedentes de delitos.
eligibility: Job seekers in the Birmingham area facing barriers to employment, including a criminal record; free walk-in services on Mondays and Wednesdays or by appointment.
eligibility_es: Personas que buscan empleo en el área de Birmingham y enfrentan barreras para el empleo, incluido un historial penal; servicios gratuitos sin cita los lunes y miércoles o con cita previa.
notes: Walk in Monday and Wednesday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m. at 2350 Green Springs Highway, or Tuesday and Thursday at the Center Point Career Center, 2310 Center Point Parkway; call 205-323-6331 extension 1102 to schedule.
notes_es: Visite sin cita los lunes y miércoles de 10 a.m. a 2 p.m. en 2350 Green Springs Highway, o los martes y jueves en el Center Point Career Center, 2310 Center Point Parkway; llame al 205-323-6331 extensión 1102 para programar.
hours: Walk-in Monday and Wednesday, 10:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.
services: Job placement assistance|Skills training and certifications|Resume and interview preparation|Career counseling|Second Chance hiring fair connections

name: Alabama Career Center — Montgomery
description: The Montgomery Career Center is the primary public workforce access point for the River Region, offering career counseling, resume assistance, direct job placement, and classroom or on-the-job training as part of Alabama's statewide Career Center system. Veterans representatives, unemployment insurance filing assistance, and labor market information are available on-site, making it a key stop for returning residents building a work history in Montgomery, Autauga, and Elmore counties.
description_es: El Montgomery Career Center es el principal punto de acceso público a la fuerza laboral para la región del río, que ofrece asesoría de carrera, ayuda con currículums, colocación laboral directa y capacitación en el aula o en el trabajo como parte del sistema estatal de Centros de Carrera de Alabama. Hay representantes de veteranos, asistencia para presentar reclamos de seguro de desempleo e información del mercado laboral disponibles en el lugar.
eligibility: Job seekers in the Montgomery area, including people with a criminal record seeking employment services; free resource room access to computers, job listings, and training referrals.
eligibility_es: Personas que buscan empleo en el área de Montgomery, incluidas personas con antecedentes penales que buscan servicios de empleo; acceso gratuito a la sala de recursos con computadoras, listados de empleo y referencias de capacitación.
notes: Call 334-286-1746 or visit 1060 East South Boulevard Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; ask about Work Opportunity Tax Credit information for employers willing to hire people with records.
notes_es: Llame al 334-286-1746 o visite 1060 East South Boulevard de lunes a viernes de 8:00 a.m. a 5:00 p.m.; pregunte sobre el Crédito Fiscal por Oportunidad de Trabajo para empleadores dispuestos a contratar personas con antecedentes.
services: Job search and placement assistance|Resume and interview preparation|Classroom and on-the-job training|Unemployment insurance filing help|Veterans employment representatives

name: Alabama Career Center — Mobile
description: The Mobile Career Center, operated through the Southwest Alabama Partnership for Training and Employment, is the primary public workforce access point for the Gulf Coast labor market, offering job search assistance, skills training referrals, and employer connections at no cost. The center works with satellite offices in Bay Minette, Brewton, Foley, Jackson, and Monroeville to reach returning residents across Southwest Alabama who need job placement support close to home.
description_es: El Mobile Career Center, operado a través de la Southwest Alabama Partnership for Training and Employment, es el principal punto de acceso público a la fuerza laboral para el mercado laboral de la Costa del Golfo, que ofrece asistencia de búsqueda de empleo, referencias de capacitación en habilidades y conexiones con empleadores sin costo. El centro trabaja con oficinas satélite en Bay Minette, Brewton, Foley, Jackson y Monroeville.
eligibility: Job seekers in the Mobile area, including people with a criminal record; free services include job search assistance, resource room access, and training referrals.
eligibility_es: Personas que buscan empleo en el área de Mobile, incluidas personas con antecedentes penales; los servicios gratuitos incluyen asistencia de búsqueda de empleo, acceso a la sala de recursos y referencias de capacitación.
notes: Call 251-461-4146 or visit 515 Springhill Plaza Court; satellite Career Centers are located in Bay Minette, Brewton, Choctaw County, Foley, Jackson, and Monroeville for residents outside Mobile proper.
notes_es: Llame al 251-461-4146 o visite 515 Springhill Plaza Court; hay Centros de Carrera satélite en Bay Minette, Brewton, el condado de Choctaw, Foley, Jackson y Monroeville para residentes fuera de Mobile propiamente dicho.
services: Job search and placement assistance|Skills training referrals|Employer connections|Unemployment insurance information

name: Legal Services Alabama — Statewide Intake & Expungement Project
description: Legal Services Alabama provides free civil legal help statewide for low-income residents, including a dedicated Reentry Project and Expungement Program that assist formerly incarcerated individuals with clearing eligible records, restoring driver's licenses, and overcoming employment barriers tied to a criminal history. Applicants generally must be at or below 125 percent of the federal poverty level, and all intake begins through the central call center rather than walking into a local office.
description_es: Legal Services Alabama ofrece ayuda legal civil gratuita en todo el estado para residentes de bajos ingresos, incluido un Proyecto de Reinserción dedicado y un Programa de Anulación de Antecedentes que ayuda a personas anteriormente encarceladas a limpiar registros elegibles, restaurar licencias de conducir y superar barreras de empleo ligadas a un historial penal. Los solicitantes generalmente deben tener ingresos iguales o menores al 125 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza.
eligibility: Low-income Alabama residents at or below approximately 125% of the federal poverty level; expungement and reentry legal help prioritized for eligible formerly incarcerated individuals; income verification required.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Alabama de bajos ingresos con ingresos iguales o menores a aproximadamente el 125% del nivel federal de pobreza; se prioriza la ayuda legal de anulación de antecedentes y reinserción para personas anteriormente encarceladas elegibles; se requiere verificación de ingresos.
notes: Call the Call Center at 866-456-4995 (Español 888-835-3505), Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m., or apply online at legalservicesalabama.org; do not use the online application for urgent deadlines under two weeks.
notes_es: Llame al Centro de Llamadas al 866-456-4995 (Español 888-835-3505), de lunes a viernes de 8:30 a.m. a 4:30 p.m., o solicite en línea en legalservicesalabama.org; no use la solicitud en línea para plazos urgentes de menos de dos semanas.
services: Expungement and record-clearing assistance|Reentry legal services|Housing and eviction defense|Public benefits appeals|Family law assistance

name: Legal Services Alabama — Birmingham Office
description: Legal Services Alabama's Birmingham office provides free civil legal aid to low-income residents of Blount, Calhoun, Cherokee, Chilton, Clay, Cleburne, Coosa, DeKalb, Etowah, Jefferson, Randolph, St. Clair, Shelby, Talladega, and Walker counties, including housing, public benefits, family law, and community reentry matters such as record relief. LSA handles civil cases only—not criminal defense. Apply through the statewide call center before visiting the office.
description_es: La oficina de Birmingham de Legal Services Alabama ofrece asistencia legal civil gratuita a residentes de bajos ingresos de los condados Blount, Calhoun, Cherokee, Chilton, Clay, Cleburne, Coosa, DeKalb, Etowah, Jefferson, Randolph, St. Clair, Shelby, Talladega y Walker, incluyendo vivienda, beneficios públicos, derecho familiar y asuntos de reinserción comunitaria como el alivio de antecedentes. LSA maneja solo casos civiles, no defensa penal. Solicite a través del centro de llamadas estatal antes de visitar la oficina.
eligibility: Low-income residents at or below 125% of the federal poverty level in the Birmingham office's 15-county service area.
eligibility_es: Residentes de bajos ingresos al 125% o menos del nivel federal de pobreza en el área de servicio de 15 condados de la oficina de Birmingham.
notes: Apply through the statewide call center at 866-456-4995 (Spanish 888-835-3505), Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
notes_es: Solicite a través del centro de llamadas estatal al 866-456-4995 (español 888-835-3505), lunes a viernes 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours; call center Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
services: Civil legal representation|Housing and eviction defense|Public benefits advocacy|Family law|Criminal record relief and expungement

name: Legal Services Alabama — Mobile Office
description: Legal Services Alabama's Mobile office provides free civil legal aid to low-income residents of Baldwin, Choctaw, Clarke, Conecuh, Escambia, Mobile, Monroe, and Washington counties, handling housing, domestic violence protective orders, consumer, and public benefits matters for justice-involved adults along the Gulf Coast. Civil cases only—not criminal defense. Call the statewide intake line before visiting.
description_es: La oficina de Mobile de Legal Services Alabama ofrece asistencia legal civil gratuita a residentes de bajos ingresos de los condados Baldwin, Choctaw, Clarke, Conecuh, Escambia, Mobile, Monroe y Washington, atendiendo vivienda, órdenes de protección por violencia doméstica, asuntos de consumidor y beneficios públicos para adultos con antecedentes penales en la costa del Golfo. Solo casos civiles, no defensa penal. Llame a la línea de admisión estatal antes de visitar.
eligibility: Low-income residents at or below 125% of the federal poverty level in the Mobile office's 8-county Gulf Coast service area.
eligibility_es: Residentes de bajos ingresos al 125% o menos del nivel federal de pobreza en el área de servicio de 8 condados de la costa del Golfo de la oficina de Mobile.
notes: Apply through the statewide call center at 866-456-4995 (Spanish 888-835-3505); toll-free local line 1-800-403-4872.
notes_es: Solicite a través del centro de llamadas estatal al 866-456-4995 (español 888-835-3505); línea local gratuita 1-800-403-4872.
services: Civil legal representation|Domestic violence protective orders|Consumer law|Public benefits advocacy|Housing legal aid

name: Legal Services Alabama — Huntsville Office
description: Legal Services Alabama's Huntsville office provides free civil legal aid to low-income residents of Colbert, Cullman, Franklin, Jackson, Lauderdale, Lawrence, Limestone, Madison, Marshall, and Morgan counties, plus domestic violence cases from DeKalb County, covering housing, family law, and public benefits matters for returning citizens in north Alabama. Civil legal aid only—not criminal defense.
description_es: La oficina de Huntsville de Legal Services Alabama ofrece asistencia legal civil gratuita a residentes de bajos ingresos de los condados Colbert, Cullman, Franklin, Jackson, Lauderdale, Lawrence, Limestone, Madison, Marshall y Morgan, además de casos de violencia doméstica del condado DeKalb, cubriendo vivienda, derecho familiar y beneficios públicos para ciudadanos que regresan en el norte de Alabama. Solo asistencia legal civil, no defensa penal.
eligibility: Low-income residents at or below 125% of the federal poverty level in the Huntsville office's 10-county north Alabama service area.
